scope: Exact small finite models only. No ACS pool read, no release fitted, 2016 sealed.

randomization_payoff_at_zero_leakage.note: the solver independently recovered the reviewed channel up to relabelling of Z: reviewed q=(1,0,11/13), solved 1-q=(1,0,0.846256)

simultaneous_roles.interpretation: the XOR channel is free under the local constraint alone and unavailable once the coalition role is bound; binning the coalition view hides the leak completely, which is why fitted-model constraints are never advertised as population conditional-information certificates

lp_reference.note: pointwise likelihood-ratio bound; stricter than an average MI budget

limits: Convexity, feasibility and optimality are properties of the specified finite model.
Nothing here transfers automatically to continuous H or to the ACS population.
No rate constraint is imposed; the convex/LP characterization is known to fail when one is active.
A solver status string is not accepted as evidence; every reported channel is re-verified by recomputing cmi.
